text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why not hang out a bit differently than 
usual? Invited by Tap Dance City with 
those words, I arrived at the main street 
to find—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! Tap's Trainer, let's have some fun 
together today♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Today we decided to 'enjoy an 
American-style after school.'

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We got all hyped up talking about our time 
in America. Come join the party with us! 
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at everyone's smiles, you can 
really tell just how much they were 
looking forward to today.
choice_data_list: Of course! Let's have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Rhythmic western tunes! Staff rolling 
around on roller skates! This is a true 
American diner!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The whole menu's in English? That's so 
authentic! Ask me if there are any words 
you don't know, okay, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
It's fine! Don't worry about me, go ahead 
and pick from the menu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than have them fuss over me, I 
wanted them to just enjoy themselves. 
Thinking that, I quickly placed my 
order... but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, that's a whole mountain of 
french fries, isn't it! I had no idea you 
were so hungryâª
choice_data_list: I just ordered like normal, though...!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! America's got super-sized 
portions compared to Japan, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made a mistake... I'll have to be more 
careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next, at the casino cafe they visited in 
the early afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now things are heating up! Of course I 
accept the challengeâI'm all in!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You're on! With a bet this big, if I win, 
it's instant riches... It's truly the 
American Dream!!"
choice_data_list: I'm in too— showdown! Open 'em up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What unbelievable spirit! ...Wait, 
hold on—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, your hand doesn't have any yaku, does 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Poker requires a cool head. Though 
having fun is how you settle your nerves 
in the first place!
choice_data_list:
(I'm not used to this, so I messed up 
again...!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And last is a dance club! Back when I 
lived in Kentucky, I used to dream about 
them as grown-up fun♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's a good rhythm going! Come on, 
Trainer, you too—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hey, what's wrong? Why the long face?
choice_data_list:
Go have fun with everyone who's used to 
dancing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I hold everyone back again, this time I 
really will ruin our fun together. 
Thinking about that makes me feel like I'm 
better off staying here...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on. Don't tell me you aren't 
confident in your dancing?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter what kind of steps you 
do— as long as you're having fun, that's 
all that counts!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's what goofing off with your friends 
is all about!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come back once you've steeled your 
resolve. You're always welcome to dance 
with my crew!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To Tap, "who" she plays with is probably 
far more important than "how" she plays.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...So, what about you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Who" you're with matters more. If that's 
the case, what I need right now is—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Finally decided to show up?! I'm 
already burning at peak heat over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I step onto the dance floor and begin to 
move. However, my feet get tangled up—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I almost tripped there. Well, 
happens all the time!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Or are you still afraid of failing... 
after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true. Right now, my heart is 
pounding with excitement. Because—"
choice_data_list: Dancing with you is so much fun!
Dancing with you is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Let's empty our heads and party 
hard, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If it's with you, I feel like I could 
dance until the end of the world!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♪ You two seem completely lost in 
the dance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll leave her alone for a while!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Until the sky was dyed in madder red, I 
danced passionately with Tap Dance 
City...”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Is it already this late?! We'd better 
head back!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I only remember laughing! Reminded me of 
my time back in the States."
choice_data_list:
I'd be really happy if you invited me 
again.
That American-style fun was the best!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey come on, bro. You'd be happy if I 
invited you, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey come on, sis. You'd be happy if I 
invited you, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even if you turn me down and say you hate 
it, I'm still gonna invite you, obviously!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Spending time with you was never boring, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Great! I'm so glad you like it death♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then where to next? Watching a musical 
might not be a bad idea!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reminiscing about American-style 
entertainment, Tap Dance City and the 
others shared a laugh.
